args.content:
Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation - June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Based on the planned activities, here is the recommended packing list:

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport, ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Wallet and credit cards
- Phone and charger

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Swimwear (multiple suits recommended)
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended)
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Flip flops/water shoes
- Reusable water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOORS:
- Hiking gear (hiking shoes, daypack, hat)
- Lightweight breathable clothing
- Rain jacket (just in case)

CASUAL ATTIRE:
- Casual outfits for daytime
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light cardigan or jacket for evenings

ENTERTAINMENT & MEMORIES:
- Camera or smartphone for photos
- Portable charger/power bank
- Book or e-reader for relaxation days

HEALTH & WELLNESS:
- Basic first aid kit
- Any personal medications
- Hand sanitizer

SPECIAL ACTIVITIES:
- Luau-appropriate attire (casual Hawaiian wear)
- Snorkeling equipment (or rent on-site)

Don't forget to check the weather forecast before packing!
